# ctyun_flow_packages (Data Source)
-> 查询流量包列表



## Example

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ctyun = {
      source = "ctyun-it/ctyun"
    }
  }
}

# 可参考index.md，在环境变量中配置ak、sk、资源池ID、可用区名称
provider "ctyun" {
  env = "prod"
}

data "ctyun_flow_packages" "test" {
}

output "ctyun_test" {
  value = data.ctyun_flow_packages.test
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region_id` (String) 资源池id，如果不填则默认使用provider ctyun中的region_id或环境变量中的CTYUN_REGION_ID

### Read-Only

- `flow_packages` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flow_packages))

<a id="nestedatt--flow_packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flow_packages`

Read-Only:

- `cycle_type` (String) 支持的取值：包小时、包天、包周、包月、包年
- `effective_time` (String) 生效时间
- `expire_time` (String) 过期时间
- `id` (String) 流量包ID
- `left_volume` (Number) 剩余流量
- `master_resource_id` (String) 资源id
- `package_name` (String) 套餐名
- `status` (String) 状态，可能的取值：初始、有效、退订、过期、销毁
- `total_volume` (Number) 总流量
